start: Owner on the Challenges page; members have logged workouts in the last 30 days

user_sees: "Rank by" with the two ways to rank
Up to 10 members in order with their totals
On each row "Hide from the leaderboard"
must_not: More than 10 rows
A member of another gym or branch
Totals older than 30 days counted

steps.action: Tap "Hide from the leaderboard" on a member
user_sees: A toast "<name> is hidden from the leaderboard."
The row shows the pill "Hidden" and the button "Show again"
The member under "Hidden from members"
must_not: The member still shown to other members in the app
Another member hidden
The member's workouts deleted

start: Owner on the Challenges page, Leaderboard card

steps.action: Under "Rank by" pick the other way (workouts or kg lifted)
user_sees: The top 10 in the new order ("Top {n} by kg lifted")
must_not: The same order as before
A hidden member counted as visible in one ranking only

start: Owner on the Challenges page of a gym where nobody has logged a workout

user_sees: "No member has logged a workout in the last 30 days yet."
must_not: An empty numbered list
A hide button with nobody to hide

steps.action: In a gym with workouts but none in the picked ranking
user_sees: "Nobody to show yet. Totals appear after members train and open the MettleUp app."
must_not: A row with 0 as a rank

steps.action: Tap "Hide from the leaderboard" with the internet off
user_sees: The button is greyed without internet, or an error line in the card
must_not: A toast that says hidden while members still see the name

start: Owner on the Leaderboard card; one member is hidden

steps.action: Under "Hidden from members" tap "Show again" on the member
user_sees: A toast "<name> is on the leaderboard again."
The member leaves "Hidden from members"; the "Hidden" pill goes
must_not: The member still missing in the member app

user_sees: "<name> is hidden from the leaderboard."
must_not: The member listed twice under "Hidden from members"

steps.action: Hide a member who asked not to be shown, then look at the list
user_sees: The owner still sees the member, marked "Hidden"; members do not

A member who switched their own name off shown by name to other members
Leaderboard numbers kept after the member leaves the gym
